title: 上海高考翻译背诵-84-SSP高考专刊

items.zh: 真希望自己的文章有朝一日能在杂志上刊登。
items.en: I do hope my own article can be published in a magazine someday.

items.zh: 将来过怎样的生活取决于你自己,因此你要努力奋斗,实现梦想。
items.en: What kind of life you will live in the future is up to you, so strive to realize your dreams.

items.zh: 随着经济快速发展,如今人们担心的不再是如何填饱肚子,而是如何防止发胖。
items.en: With the rapid development of the economy, what worries people today is more how to avoid gaining weight than how to feed themselves.

items.zh: 有目共睹的是,当地政府多年来坚持人与自然和谐共处的理念,这对保护生物多样性有积极影响。
items.en: It is obvious that the local government has been sticking to the philosophy of being in harmony with nature for years, which has a positive influence on the protection of biodiversity.
